labels.shortDescription: Title of the Rollups page in the BarnCRM Settings console.
labels.value: Rollups

labels.shortDescription: Intro line on the Rollups page.
labels.value: Every total BarnCRM keeps up to date for you, and when each one was last calculated.

labels.shortDescription: Column heading for the rollup name and description.
labels.value: Rollup

labels.shortDescription: Column heading for the source of a rollup.
labels.value: What it counts

labels.shortDescription: Added to what a text list counts: {0} is the delimiter, such as semicolon.
labels.value: separated by {0}

labels.shortDescription: Column heading for when a rollup is recalculated.
labels.value: Mode

labels.shortDescription: Column heading for the active toggle.
labels.value: Active

labels.shortDescription: Column heading for the time a rollup last completed.
labels.value: Last calculated

labels.shortDescription: Button that recalculates every rollup for one kind of record.
labels.value: Recalculate all

labels.shortDescription: Message shown when a recalculation is started.
labels.value: Recalculation started. This page updates as it finishes.

labels.shortDescription: Button that creates the nightly recalculation schedule.
labels.value: Schedule nightly recalculation

labels.shortDescription: Status when the nightly run is scheduled: {0} is its time
labels.value: Nightly recalculation is scheduled for {0}.

labels.shortDescription: Status shown when the nightly schedule does not exist.
labels.value: Nightly recalculation is not scheduled yet.

labels.shortDescription: Message shown to a user without the settings permission.
labels.value: You can see these totals but not change them. Ask an administrator for the Manage BarnCRM Settings permission.

labels.shortDescription: Error returned when a user without the permission tries to change a rollup.
labels.value: You do not have permission to change rollups.

labels.shortDescription: Error returned when a rollup id does not resolve.
labels.value: That rollup no longer exists. Refresh the page and try again.

labels.shortDescription: Error returned when a mode value is not one of the three.
labels.value: That is not a rollup mode. Choose Instantly, Every night, or Both (recommended).

labels.shortDescription: Info logged when a rollup names an object the org does not have.
labels.value: The records this rollup counts are not in this org, so it was skipped.

labels.shortDescription: Error when Any or None is set to fill a field that is not a checkbox.
labels.value: Any and None show their answer in a checkbox field. Choose a checkbox field for this rollup, or choose another calculation.

labels.shortDescription: Error when a text list is set to fill a field that is not text.
labels.value: A text list shows its answer in a text field. Choose a text or long text field for this rollup, or choose another calculation.

labels.shortDescription: Error when Count distinct is set to fill a field that is not a number.
labels.value: Count distinct shows its answer in a number field. Choose a number field for this rollup, or choose another calculation.

labels.shortDescription: Error when a checkbox field is given a calculation other than Any or None.
labels.value: A checkbox field can show only Any or None. Choose one of those calculations, or choose another field.

labels.shortDescription: Error when a text field is given a calculation that does not produce text.
labels.value: A text field can show only First, Last or a text list. Choose one of those calculations, or choose another field.

labels.shortDescription: Error when the field chosen to show a rollup cannot hold its calculation.
labels.value: That field cannot show this calculation. Choose a number, currency, percent or date field, or choose another calculation.

labels.shortDescription: Error when the field chosen to show a rollup is missing or cannot be written.
labels.value: BarnCRM cannot write to the field this rollup fills. Choose a field that exists and is not a formula or read only.

labels.shortDescription: Error when a calculation that reads a field on each record has no Source Field.
labels.value: This calculation reads a field on each record. Fill in Source Field with the field to read.

labels.shortDescription: Recalculate one rollup
labels.value: Recalculate

labels.shortDescription: Stop the nightly schedule
labels.value: Stop the nightly recalculation

labels.shortDescription: Restore the shipped rollups
labels.value: Restore shipped rollups

labels.shortDescription: No rollups yet
labels.value: No rollups are set up yet. Restore the shipped rollups to start with the ones BarnCRM provides.

labels.shortDescription: Target column heading
labels.value: Where it shows

labels.shortDescription: Never calculated
labels.value: Not calculated yet

labels.shortDescription: Unexpected rollup error
labels.value: Something went wrong on the Rollups page. The Error Log has the details.

labels.shortDescription: Rollup Queue: a record's totals could not be saved; {0} is the reason
labels.value: The totals could not be saved: {0} BarnCRM tries again automatically, and the nightly run puts them right if it still cannot.

labels.shortDescription: Rollup Queue: a background recalculation stopped; {0} is the reason
labels.value: The background recalculation stopped before it finished: {0} BarnCRM tries these records again, a few at a time.

labels.shortDescription: Rollup Queue: an entry held by the large record background job
labels.value: These records have too many rows behind their totals for one background run, so a separate background job is recalculating them a few thousand rows at a time. If they are still waiting an hour after that job last made progress, it stopped before it finished, and BarnCRM tries again.

labels.shortDescription: Error Log: queued totals not saved; {0} is the record count
labels.value: {0} records' totals could not be saved in the background and wait in the Rollup Queue. They are tried again automatically; after five tries they wait for Retry.

labels.shortDescription: Error Log: full recalculation skipped while automation is paused.
labels.value: The rollup recalculation did not run because all automation is paused. It runs again tonight, or click Recalculate all once automation is back on.

labels.shortDescription: Error Log: full recalculation skipped while the module is turned off.
labels.value: The rollup recalculation did not run because BarnCRM Rollup Builder is turned off on Modules. Turning it on recalculates every rollup.

labels.shortDescription: Error Log: a running recalculation stopped because the module was turned off.
labels.value: A rollup recalculation stopped partway because BarnCRM Rollup Builder was turned off on Modules. Turning it on recalculates every rollup.

labels.shortDescription: Error Log: a scheduled rollup run skipped while the module is turned off.
labels.value: The scheduled rollup run was skipped because BarnCRM Rollup Builder is turned off on Modules. Turning it on recalculates every rollup.

labels.shortDescription: Error: Recalculate refused while the module is turned off.
labels.value: BarnCRM Rollup Builder is turned off on Modules. Turn it on to recalculate.

labels.shortDescription: Error Log: full run incomplete; {0} records not saved, {1} batches stopped
labels.value: The rollup recalculation finished, but {0} records' totals could not be saved and {1} batches of records stopped before they finished. The saves are tried again automatically; rollups whose records stopped are not marked calculated and are put right by the next run.

labels.shortDescription: Rollups page: a full recalculation is already running.
labels.value: A full recalculation is already running. Its totals will be on the records when it finishes, so try again after that.

labels.shortDescription: Error Log: full run not started, one running; {0} is the job Id
labels.value: A rollup recalculation did not start because another one was still running (job {0}). The running one brings the totals up to date.

labels.shortDescription: Error Log: a stopped chunk's records were queued; {0} is the count
labels.value: Part of a rollup recalculation stopped before it finished. The totals of its {0} records are recalculated in the background within minutes.
